simple.meaning: יְרַחְמְאֵלִי (Yᵉrachmᵉʼêlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
